package validators

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
)

func htmlTestContext(t *testing.T) context.Context {
	t.Helper()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Second)
	t.Cleanup(cancel)
	return ctx
}

// These explicit wire fixtures test the consumer, not the HTML engine's
// vendored in-process NATS transport. Never subscribe to its real subject.
func htmlNamedWireFixture(t *testing.T, body *string) *HTMLValidator {
	t.Helper()
	address := os.Getenv("T104_HTML_UNIT_NATS_URL")
	if address == "" {
		t.Skip("requires the owned isolated consumer wire-fixture broker")
	}
	conn, err := natsgo.Connect(address, natsgo.Timeout(2*time.Second))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("connect named HTML consumer wire fixture: %v", err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(conn.Close)
	subject := "t104.html.consumer.wire." + uuid.NewString()
	if body != nil {
		_, err := conn.Subscribe(subject, func(msg *natsgo.Msg) { _ = msg.Respond([]byte(*body)) })
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("subscribe named HTML consumer wire fixture: %v", err)
		}
		if err := conn.FlushTimeout(2 * time.Second); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("flush named HTML consumer wire fixture: %v", err)
		}
	}
	return &HTMLValidator{conn: conn, subject: subject}
}

func htmlHTTPWireFixture(t *testing.T, status int, body string) *HTMLValidator {
	t.Helper()
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.Method != http.MethodPost || r.URL.Path != "/validate" {
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		w.WriteHeader(status)
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(body))
	}))
	t.Cleanup(server.Close)
	return &HTMLValidator{baseURL: server.URL}
}

func TestHTMLValidatorDirectConsumersRejectProtocolFixtures(t *testing.T) {
	cases := map[string]string{
		"missing_outcome":          `{"errors":[]}`,
		"null_outcome":             `{"isValid":null,"errors":[]}`,
		"missing_errors":           `{"isValid":true}`,
		"null_errors":              `{"isValid":true,"errors":null}`,
		"string_outcome":           `{"isValid":"true","errors":[]}`,
		"wrong_errors_shape":       `{"isValid":false,"errors":{}}`,
		"positive_with_errors":     `{"isValid":true,"errors":[{"code":"MISSING_ELEMENT","message":"Element missing"}]}`,
		"configuration_envelope":   `{"error":{"code":"HTML_RULES_UNAVAILABLE","message":"provider-private-source"}}`,
		"configuration_with_pass":  `{"error":{"code":"HTML_RULES_UNAVAILABLE","message":"provider-private-source"},"isValid":true,"errors":[]}`,
		"malformed_json":           `provider-private-source`,
		"trailing_json":            `{"isValid":true,"errors":[]} {"private":"provider-private-source"}`,
		"null_response":            `null`,
		"null_semantic_error":      `{"isValid":false,"errors":[null]}`,
		"nonobject_semantic_error": `{"isValid":false,"errors":["provider-private-source"]}`,
		"missing_error_code":       `{"isValid":false,"errors":[{"message":"Element missing"}]}`,
		"missing_error_message":    `{"isValid":false,"errors":[{"code":"MISSING_ELEMENT"}]}`,
		"blank_error_code":         `{"isValid":false,"errors":[{"code":" ","message":"Element missing"}]}`,
		"null_error_message":       `{"isValid":false,"errors":[{"code":"MISSING_ELEMENT","message":null}]}`,
		"nonstring_error_message":  `{"isValid":false,"errors":[{"code":"MISSING_ELEMENT","message":123}]}`,
		"malformed_semantic_error": `{"isValid":false,"errors":[{"code":123,"message":"provider-private-source"}]}`,
	}
	for name, body := range cases {
		for _, transport := range []string{"HTTP_named_wire_fixture", "NATS_named_wire_fixture"} {
			t.Run(transport+"/"+name, func(t *testing.T) {
				var validator *HTMLValidator
				if transport == "HTTP_named_wire_fixture" {
					validator = htmlHTTPWireFixture(t, http.StatusOK, body)
				} else {
					validator = htmlNamedWireFixture(t, &body)
				}
				result, err := validator.ValidateAll(htmlTestContext(t), "task", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "index.html", Content: "<main/>"}})
				if err == nil || result != nil {
					t.Fatalf("protocol/config fixture must be technical without learner result: result=%#v error=%v", result, err)
				}
				for _, forbidden := range []string{"provider-private", "invalid character", "cannot unmarshal", "unexpected end of JSON"} {
					if strings.Contains(err.Error(), forbidden) {
						t.Fatalf("provider body/parser detail exposed: %v", err)
					}
				}
			})
		}
	}
}

func TestHTMLValidatorDirectConsumersPreserveSemanticResults(t *testing.T) {
	for _, body := range []string{`{"isValid":true,"errors":[]}`, `{"isValid":false,"errors":[]}`, `{"isValid":false,"errors":[{"code":"TEXT_MISMATCH","message":"Text differs","path":"body[0]"}]}`} {
		for _, transport := range []string{"HTTP_named_wire_fixture", "NATS_named_wire_fixture"} {
			t.Run(transport+"/"+body, func(t *testing.T) {
				var validator *HTMLValidator
				if transport == "HTTP_named_wire_fixture" {
					validator = htmlHTTPWireFixture(t, http.StatusOK, body)
				} else {
					validator = htmlNamedWireFixture(t, &body)
				}
				result, err := validator.ValidateAll(htmlTestContext(t), "task", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "index.html", Content: "<main/>"}})
				var expected struct {
					IsValid bool `json:"isValid"`
					Errors  []struct {
						Code string `json:"code"`
					} `json:"errors"`
				}
				_ = json.Unmarshal([]byte(body), &expected)
				if err != nil || result == nil || result.Valid != expected.IsValid {
					t.Fatalf("semantic result changed: result=%#v error=%v", result, err)
				}
				if len(result.Errors) != len(expected.Errors) || (len(result.Errors) != 0 && result.Errors[0].Code != "TEXT_MISMATCH") {
					t.Fatalf("semantic learner failure lost: %#v", result)
				}
			})
		}
	}
}

func TestHTMLValidatorHTTPNon200DoesNotExposeBody(t *testing.T) {
	for _, status := range []int{http.StatusBadRequest, http.StatusInternalServerError} {
		validator := htmlHTTPWireFixture(t, status, `{"error":{"code":"HTML_RULES_REQUIRED","message":"provider-private-source"}}`)
		result, err := validator.ValidateAll(htmlTestContext(t), "task", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "index.html", Content: "<main/>"}})
		if err == nil || result != nil || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "provider-private-source") || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "HTML_RULES_REQUIRED") {
			t.Fatalf("non200 must be safe technical error: result=%#v error=%v", result, err)
		}
	}
}

func TestHTMLValidatorDirectConsumersPreserveBlankSemanticMessages(t *testing.T) {
	for name, message := range map[string]string{"blank": "", "whitespace": " "} {
		for _, transport := range []string{"HTTP", "NATS"} {
			t.Run(transport+"/"+name, func(t *testing.T) {
				data, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"isValid": false, "errors": []any{map[string]string{
					"code": "TAG_MISMATCH", "message": message, "path": "body[0]",
				}}})
				body := string(data)
				var validator *HTMLValidator
				if transport == "HTTP" {
					validator = htmlHTTPWireFixture(t, http.StatusOK, body)
				} else {
					validator = htmlNamedWireFixture(t, &body)
				}
				result, err := validator.ValidateAll(htmlTestContext(t), "task", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "index.html", Content: "<h1/>"}})
				if err != nil || result == nil || result.Valid || len(result.Errors) != 1 {
					t.Fatalf("authored blank message must remain semantic failure: result=%#v error=%v", result, err)
				}
				if result.Errors[0].Code != "TAG_MISMATCH" || result.Errors[0].Message != message {
					t.Fatalf("authored message changed: %#v", result.Errors[0])
				}
			})
		}
	}
}

func TestHTMLValidatorDirectConsumersPreservePathMapping(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		transport, providerPath, expectedPath string
	}{
		{"HTTP", "", "index.html"},
		{"HTTP", " body[0] ", "body[0]"},
		{"NATS", "", ""},
		{"NATS", " body[0] ", " body[0] "},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.transport+"/"+tc.providerPath, func(t *testing.T) {
			data, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"isValid": false, "errors": []any{map[string]string{
				"code": "TEXT_MISMATCH", "message": "Text differs", "path": tc.providerPath,
			}}})
			body := string(data)
			var validator *HTMLValidator
			if tc.transport == "HTTP" {
				validator = htmlHTTPWireFixture(t, http.StatusOK, body)
			} else {
				validator = htmlNamedWireFixture(t, &body)
			}
			result, err := validator.ValidateAll(htmlTestContext(t), "task", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "index.html", Content: "<main/>"}})
			if err != nil || result == nil || len(result.Errors) != 1 || result.Errors[0].File != tc.expectedPath {
				t.Fatalf("existing path mapping changed: result=%#v error=%v", result, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestHTMLValidatorNamedWireTransportFailuresAreTechnical(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("no_responder_fixture_not_engine_proof", func(t *testing.T) {
		validator := htmlNamedWireFixture(t, nil)
		result, err := validator.ValidateAll(htmlTestContext(t), "task", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "index.html", Content: "<main/>"}})
		if err == nil || result != nil {
			t.Fatalf("no responder must be technical: result=%#v error=%v", result, err)
		}
	})
	t.Run("cancelled_context", func(t *testing.T) {
		validator := htmlNamedWireFixture(t, nil)
		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		cancel()
		result, err := validator.ValidateAll(ctx, "task", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "index.html", Content: "<main/>"}})
		if err == nil || result != nil {
			t.Fatalf("cancelled request must be technical: result=%#v error=%v", result, err)
		}
	})
}
